task.description: Produce ADP-07 test specification mapping acceptance criteria to deterministic executable tests. Ensure coverage includes AGENT_RUNNER role grantability, non-admin rejection for agent: usernames, admin allowance for agent: usernames, and no-regression behavior for non-agent identities. Align test design with implemented integration test surfaces and include any missing negative/edge cases required for release confidence.
acceptance_criteria: Test spec exists at tests/specs/ADP-07.md with explicit traceability to ADP-07 acceptance criteria
Spec includes deterministic positive and negative cases for reserved username enforcement by actor role
Spec includes AGENT_RUNNER grantability and compatibility assertions
Spec identifies execution targets in existing test suites and any required additions
Spec is actionable for TEST-RUNNER without ambiguity

result.summary: Produced ADP-07 test specification with deterministic traceability to integration evidence for AGENT_RUNNER grantability, reserved username actor-policy enforcement, and non-agent compatibility; added missing executable no-regression case to ADP-07 integration tests.
